title: Naturality of localized integral beta components
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne D.p$, and a separated finite-type $D.k$-scheme $X$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $E,L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ and $i:E\to L$ a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra embedding. Let $w_E,w_L$ be coherent integral dualizing data [def-sf-coherent-integral-dualizing-datum], and $A,B$ supplied normalized rational Verdier data [def-sf-rational-verdier-data]. Write $Q_E,Q_L$ for the raw rational localizations, $T$ for integral scalar extension, and $\bar T$ for its rational scalar extension [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Write $D_E=A.\mathrm{dual}$ and $D_L=B.\mathrm{dual}$, and $\beta_K$ for the actual evaluation-transpose integral comparison in the presentations $A.\mathrm{ordinary},B.\mathrm{ordinary}$ [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core]. Suppose $c_K:\bar T(D_EK)\to D_L(\bar TK)$ is a family of arrows, with $c_{Q_EK_0}=Q_L(\beta_{K_0})$ for every integral constructible $K_0$, with endpoints identified by the object equations of $A,B$ and scalar extension. For every rational arrow $f:K\to M$, one has $\bar T(D_E f)c_K=c_M D_L(\bar T f)$, in left-to-right categorical composition. No invertibility, dualizing comparison, evaluation square or biduality equation is asserted.

lean.statement:
theorem localizedBeta_naturality
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra (Padic l) L] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) L]
    (i : E →ₐ[Padic l] L)
    (wE : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (wL : IntegralFiniteExtension.DualizingDatum l X D hl L)
    (A : Datum D l hl X E wE) (B : Datum D l hl X L wL)
    (c : ∀ K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X,
      (scalar l X E L i).obj (A.dual.obj (op K)) ⟶
        B.dual.obj (op ((scalar l X E L i).obj K)))
    (hc : (∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X,
    HEq (c ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l E X).obj K))
      ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l L X).map
        (ObjectProperty.homMk
          (X := (integralScalar l X E L i).obj
            ((IntegralVerdier.restrictedDual l E X wE.omega.obj A.preserves).obj (op K)))
          (Y := (IntegralVerdier.restrictedDual l L X wL.omega.obj B.preserves).obj
            (op ((integralScalar l X E L i).obj K)))
          (IntegralFiniteExtension.beta l E L i X D hl wE wL A.ordinary B.ordinary
            K.obj K.property.1))))) :
    ∀ (K M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X) (f : K ⟶ M),
      (A.dual ⋙ scalar l X E L i).map f.op ≫ c K =
        c M ≫ ((scalar l X E L i).op ⋙ B.dual).map f.op
